import cv2, numpy as np

img17 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0017.png')
# Chair 1 in obs 17:
ys1, xs1 = np.where((img17[:,:,2] > 80) & (img17[:,:,2] < 150) & (img17[:,:,1] > 35) & (img17[:,:,1] < 80) & (img17[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 150))
print('obs 17 Chair 1: y in [', ys1.min(), ys1.max(), '], x in [', xs1.min(), xs1.max(), ']')

# Chair 2 in obs 17:
ys2, xs2 = np.where((img17[:,:,2] > 80) & (img17[:,:,2] < 150) & (img17[:,:,1] > 35) & (img17[:,:,1] < 80) & (img17[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 350))
print('obs 17 Chair 2: y in [', ys2.min(), ys2.max(), '], x in [', xs2.min(), xs2.max(), ']')

# Look at bottom of legs for Chair 1 in obs 17:
d_c1_17 = 256 * 1.55 / (ys1.max() - 255.5)
d_c2_17 = 256 * 1.55 / (ys2.max() - 255.5)
print(f'obs 17 Chair 1 dist = {d_c1_17:.2f}, obs 17 Chair 2 dist = {d_c2_17:.2f}')
"
